messages.landing.what.heading: A goldfish that remembers
messages.landing.what.body: Memex is a knowledge base you talk to. Keep the things worth knowing — dates, places, plans, preferences — and ask for them later, in your own words, from any conversation or language. Share the link and everyone draws on the same memory.
messages.landing.how.heading: How to use it
messages.landing.how.remember.title: Tell it something
messages.landing.how.remember.body: Say it the way you'd say it out loud, not in a form.
messages.landing.how.ask.title: Ask for it back
messages.landing.how.ask.body: Ask in everyday language — no folders, tags, or exact wording.
messages.landing.how.share.title: Share if you want
messages.landing.how.share.body: Send the link, or keep it to yourself. Everyone with the link remembers the same things.
messages.landing.examples.heading: Give anything a memory
messages.landing.example.family.title: A family
messages.landing.example.family.body: Stories, recipes, names, and half-remembered history contributed across generations and languages.
messages.landing.example.family.question: Why did Nana call the old house ‘The Ship’?
messages.landing.example.world.title: A fictional world
messages.landing.example.world.body: Characters, places, rules, clues, and canon remembered across campaigns or writing sessions.
messages.landing.example.world.question: Who knows that Captain Ilya is an impostor?
messages.landing.example.place.title: A living place
messages.landing.example.place.body: Years of accumulated knowledge about a garden, workshop, building, farm, or neighbourhood.
messages.landing.example.place.question: What finally stopped the mildew in the north greenhouse?
messages.landing.example.project.title: A project
messages.landing.example.project.body: Decisions, failed approaches, conventions, and the reasoning that disappears when people leave.
messages.landing.example.project.question: Why did we abandon the original sync protocol?
messages.settings.languageLocked: Everything I remember is stored in this language, so it can't be changed after the memex is created.
messages.settings.appLanguageHint: Changes the app's interface language only. You can talk to Memex in any language — it answers in the language you write.
messages.settings.exportHint: Saves everything in this memex — memories and requests.
